Did subtyping detect an ADHD group?

```{r}
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(metasnf)
library(ggplot2)

import <- function(path) {
    return(abcd_load(core_path(path)))
}

proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
core_path <- path_maker(here("data/abcd/core"))
fig_path <- path_maker(here::here("data/abcd/results/figures"))

#all_dls_h_ns <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_09_11_all_dls_h_no_sibs.rds"))

mtbi_ful_df <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_09_16_mtbi_ful_df.rds"))
mh_p_cbcl <- import("mental-health/mh_p_cbcl.csv")

adhd_plot <- mh_p_cbcl |>
    filter_timepoint(0) |>
    filter_subjects(gsub("uid_", "", mtbi_ful_df$"uid")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(uid = paste0("uid_", subjectkey)) |>
    dplyr::select(uid, "cbcl_scr_dsm5_adhd_r", "cbcl_scr_dsm5_adhd_t") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(mtbi_ful_df) |>
    ggplot(
        aes(
            x = cluster,
            y = cbcl_scr_dsm5_adhd_r,
            colour = cluster
        )
    ) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_jitter(
        size = 3,
        height = 0.1,
        width = 0.3,
        alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    labs(
        y = "CBCL DSM5 ADHD Raw",
        x = "Cluster",
        colour = "Cluster"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

# Does not seem like an ADHD group was detected

ggsave(
    fig_path("adhd_cluster.png", TRUE),
    adhd_plot,
    width = 4,
    height = 3.5
)
```
